change_summary: 在 00-data-fetch.yml 的 artifact 上傳步驟加上 if: always()，並在下游 workflow 的觸發 job 加上 conclusion 判斷，使 exit 1 時仍上傳 artifact 並讓下游在 success/failure 時執行、cancelled 時跳過。

diffs.diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/00-data-fetch.yml b/.github/workflows/00-data-fetch.yml
index 32317ce..3279973 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/00-data-fetch.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/00-data-fetch.yml
@@ -91,6 +91,7 @@ jobs:
           python scripts/data/compute_rolling.py
 
       - name: Step 4 - Upload artifacts
+        if: always()
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
           name: institutional-data-${{ github.run_id }}

diff --git a/.github/workflows/10-screener-setup-a.yml b/.github/workflows/10-screener-setup-a.yml
index 537e684..c35a864 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/10-screener-setup-a.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/10-screener-setup-a.yml
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ jobs:
   screener-setup-a:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     needs: guardrail
-    if: ${{ needs.guardrail.outputs.passed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
+    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (needs.guardrail.outputs.passed == 'true' && (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure')) }}
 
     steps:
       - name: Checkout repository

diff --git a/.github/workflows/20-manager-loop.yml b/.github/workflows/20-manager-loop.yml
index b9f4504..c8423d4 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/20-manager-loop.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/20-manager-loop.yml
@@ -13,7 +13,7 @@ jobs:
   manager-loop:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     needs: guardrail
-    if: ${{ needs.guardrail.outputs.passed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
+    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (needs.guardrail.outputs.passed == 'true' && (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure')) }}
 
     steps:
       - name: Checkout repository

behavior_after_fix.scenario_typhoon_skip: Python 腳本因跳過日期 exit 1 時，00-data-fetch.yml 的 Step 4 因 if: always() 仍會上傳 artifact；下游 workflow 因 workflow_run types 為 [completed] 會被觸發，且 upstream conclusion 為 failure，滿足 'success' || 'failure' 條件，因此下游會執行並可下載到 artifact。
behavior_after_fix.scenario_cancelled: 人工 cancel 00-data-fetch.yml 時，upstream conclusion 為 cancelled，下游 job 的 if 條件不滿足，因此下游不會執行。
behavior_after_fix.scenario_normal_success: 正常 exit 0 時，upstream conclusion 為 success，滿足下游條件；artifact 本來就會上傳，因此行為與修改前一致，唯一差異是多了 always() 保護。
